subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Title mark 'SKYBREAK' with 'ISAF · MOBIUS 1' subline; CONTINUE resumes the most recently updated record, shown as BEGIN CAMPAIGN on a fresh profile
subjectiveDecisions.why: Owner asked for an original SKYBREAK command title; CONTINUE on an empty profile misdescribes it; NEW GAME implies a destructive reset the save model does not offer.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Record → hub; CONTINUE and post-success → briefing; START MISSION → aircraft → objective confirmation → launch; RETRY → objective confirmation
subjectiveDecisions.why: Follows the manual's pre-mission hierarchy while every launch passes an explicit confirmation; mandatory chapters still play before launch.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Interface-owned focus (arrows/WASD/D-pad/stick, Enter/A, Backspace/B), Roblox GUI selection cleared on menus; Space excluded from confirm
subjectiveDecisions.why: One deterministic, testable focus with remembered positions; Space fires missiles and could skip a debrief.

subjectiveDecisions.status: Implemented in staged source; needs native visual comparison
subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Michroma for commands/tags, Titillium Web for prose, Roboto Mono for numerals; navy/grid/cyan/red tokens from the audit
subjectiveDecisions.why: Michroma is the closest bundled wide technical face to the inspected lettering; prose stays readable. No original typeface is claimed.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Aircraft screen uses an original generic plan-view schematic, catalog GUN/MSL and the actual 4AAM salvo; no prices or stats
subjectiveDecisions.why: No client-side model exists before a sortie and the gameplay meshes are not per-type; invented stats or shop data would be false.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Briefing shows only opening forces and the first objective; strategic step shows the whole mission area
subjectiveDecisions.why: Avoids future-phase spoilers and fabricated geography; theatre map waits for original geography data.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: HUD distances in feet using the existing ALT ×5 convention; radar shows NEAR/WIDE; pointer REARM appears only south of the return line; no new key bindings
subjectiveDecisions.why: One consistent display unit; no new controls without review; crossing the line still rearms automatically.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Debrief shows score/time and only provided statistics; no rank until authoritative
subjectiveDecisions.why: Audit forbids fabricated ranks; generic rank is not AC04 output.

subjectiveDecisions.chosen: Sparse HUD with light local plates by default; HIGH backing toggle in pause, session-only
subjectiveDecisions.why: Recovers the original spatial hierarchy while keeping a legibility fallback; persisting needs a settings-store change outside scope.
